name: Forgefire Weapon
effect_summary: Kalev drives forge heat through his hammer so his next blows land hotter for a short time. Needs the hammer in hand or anvil work at his own forge. Recasting refreshes the heat instead of stacking it.

source_notes.summary: Authored conduit-gated starter recipe from the MAGIC.md section 9 stub; it exercises conduit.forge_spell and is not an attested historical practice.
